landing.hero.title: Switch presentations from your phone
landing.hero.subtitle: A free remote for Windows and macOS. No phone app required.
landing.features.title: Features
landing.features.remote: Large Back and Forward buttons, a timer, and connection status.
landing.features.speaker: Temporary links for speakers without registration.
landing.features.secure: Access only with your permission; revoke in one click.
landing.steps.title: Three steps to connect
landing.steps.one: Download and run the worker on the presentation computer.
landing.steps.three: Open the remote on your phone and switch slides.
landing.os.title: Supported systems
landing.download.title: Download
landing.download.soon: Links will appear after the first builds are released.
landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.q1: Do I need to install a phone app?
landing.faq.a1: No. The remote opens in a browser.
landing.faq.q2: Can the service see my presentation content?
landing.faq.a2: No. The worker only presses keys in the active window.
landing.faq.q3: How long does a speaker link last?
landing.faq.a3: 2 hours by default, up to 24 hours.
